name: 30528 · Cleveland, GA
findings: ZIP 30528 (Cleveland) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30528 (Cleveland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30528 (Cleveland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
